reviews.title: ضيفو مره علي الاذان وقت قد ايه مهم جدا
Disappointing priority: Profit over accurate prayer times
reviews.text:
I am incredibly disappointed by the developers' current priorities. You would think helping the community get accurate prayer times would come before rigid bureaucratic requirements, marketing, and profiting.
They actually removed our local **Masjid** from their registered list simply because they insist on having a photo of the Masjid prayer times screen that explicitly includes both the name of the Masjid and the Minbar.
I don't even work for the Masjid; I am just a local Muslim who wanted to ensure everyone in my community has access to accurate prayer times! I already provided them with the official website of the Masjid, which includes all the necessary, verified information.
Instead of working with the community to keep data accurate, they’d rather delete a Masjid entirely over a photo requirement. Please do better and prioritize community service over rigid marketing checkboxes.
